# Descriptions
@@ 1
When cast on a target before sleep, this spell prevents the target’s dream
self from entering or being drawn into the dream world for the duration of the
target’s sleep period.
@@ 2
When cast on a target (either before or after entry to the dream world), this
spell allows the target to use his skills and innate abilities at 25% of their
normal value within the dream world (for the duration of this spell). This
spell does not allow the caster to cast spells while in the dream world.
Without an Empowerment spell, a dream-self persona cannot manipulate the dream
world.
@@ 3
For the duration of this spell, the target is able to cast first level spells
while in the dream world. This spell can be cast either before or after entry
to the dream world. Without this spell, the target’s spells will have no
effect in the dream world.
@@ 4
Allows the caster to slow down the metabolism of the target’s real body for
the duration of the spell. The target’s body does not require nourishment for
the duration of the spell. The spell only functions while the target remains
in the dream world.
@@ 5
Allows the caster to draw the dream self of a sleeping target into a specific
location in the dream world chosen at time of casting. The target will remain
in the dream world for the duration of his sleep, unless an Exit Dream World
spell is employed or the dream-self is prematurely expelled. The target enters
the dream world with only his mental capabilities and the dream-self’s
pseudo-body, and needs Dream spells and y spells to manipulate the dream
world.
@@ 6
Allows the caster to force a target’s dream self out of the dream world. The
target will waken in one round after being ejected. This spell cannot be used
to eject a creature belonging to the dream world.
@@ 7
As Dream Empowerment I, except the target can use his skills and abilities at
50% of their normal value.
@@ 8
As Dream Spell I, except the target can cast up to thirrd level spells.
@@ 9
When cast on a target, this spell will provide the target’s subconscious mind
with a warning of any danger to the target’s physical body for the duration of
the spell.
@@ 10
The caster may teleport one target to a location within the dream world with
which the caster is either familiar or is familiar with its real world
equivalent. The risk of this spell depends on the caster’s familiarity with
the destination. The following chances for failure exist: Never seen place
(but has had described) = 50%; Been briefly (one hour or less) = 25%; Studied
(been in for 24 hours)=10%; Studied carefully (7 days) = 1 %. In the case of
failure, first determine the direction of the error (roll randomly) The amount
of error is then determined by making a d100 (openended) roll to determine the
distance of the error in feet.
@@ 11
This spell will inform the caster of the location in the dream world of the
dream-self of a single chosen target who must be in the dream world at time of
casting and known to the caster.
@@ 12
As Dream Spell I, except the target can cast up to fifth level spells.
@@ 13
As Dream Empowerment I, except the target can use his skills and abilities at
75% of their normal value.
@@ 14
Allows the caster to summon a dream beast. The dream beast may or may not be
friendly towards the caster, and the caster may or may not be able to summon a
specific type or individual dream beast dependent on the nature of the dream
world.
@@ 15
The target’s dream-self will be prevented from returning to his physical body.
The target may make additional RRs to break free if the physical body is
attacked or endangered during the duration of this spell.
@@ 16
As Summon Dream Beast, except the caster can summon an intelligent denizen of
the dream world.
@@ 17
The target dream beast will believe the caster is a good friend.
@@ 18
As Dream Spell I, except the target can cast up to tenth level spells.
@@ 19
As Charm Dream Beast, except this spell affects intelligent denizens of the
dream world.
@@ 20
As Dream Empowerment I, except the target can use his skills and abilities at
100% of their normal value.
@@ 25
As Dream Teleport I, except the caster may teleport up to one target per level
of the caster.
@@ 30
As Dream Spell I, except the target can cast up to twentieth level spells.
@@ 50
As Dream Spell I, except the target can cast up to fiftieth level spells.
